calls.video_title: Get Paid Every Month Without Selling a Share
calls.thesis: First pick on his monthly-dividend list: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF, holds NVDA/AAPL/MSFT and sells covered calls for income.
calls.base_case: Tech exposure plus a ~12% annual yield paid monthly.
calls.bull_case: Monthly checks keep coming even in drawdowns; dividend stocks fell less than Nasdaq in past drops.
calls.bear_case: Selling options caps upside in big rallies (74% vs Nasdaq 100% over 3 yrs); distributions mostly non-qualified (taxed as income).
